# `adt srvb`

ABAP service binding (SRVB) operations

```bash
adt srvb [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command              | Description                                            |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `adt srvb create`    | Create a new ABAP service binding                      |
| `adt srvb read`      | Read an ABAP service binding                           |
| `adt srvb publish`   | Publish (activate) an ABAP service binding via Gateway |
| `adt srvb unpublish` | Unpublish (deactivate) an ABAP service binding         |
| `adt srvb activate`  | Activate one or more ABAP service binding(s)           |
| `adt srvb delete`    | Delete an ABAP service binding                         |

## `adt srvb create`

Create a new ABAP service binding

```bash
adt srvb create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description       | Default |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | SRVB name         |         |
| `<description>` | Short description |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name      |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                 | Default |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number    |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if SRVB already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON              |         |

## `adt srvb delete`

Delete an ABAP service binding

```bash
adt srvb delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description | Default |
| -------- | ----------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | SRVB name   |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |

| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |
